rulings.Case Title: BRAD SJOLIN PROPERTIES, LLC VS. JEFFREY JOHNSON ET AL
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 13, 2026. Line 11. DEFENDANT JEFFREY JOHNSON MOTION TO STRIKE COMPLAINT is GRANTED with leave to amend within 5 days of notice of entry of order. The plaintiff in this action is Brad Sjolin Properties, LLC, which the Complaint identifies as a limited liability company. The verification is signed by a natural person, identified as Brad Sjolin, and states that he is the plaintiff in this action. It is clear from the face of the pleading that this statement is false, and the verification based on a patently false statement is improper. While the opposition asserts that Mr. Sjolin is a member Brad Sjolin Properties, LLC, this fact does not appear on the face of the challenged pleading, and therefore cannot be considered in connection with this motion to strike.=(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849). rulings.Case Title: CP CLEMENT, LLC VS. DAVID SILVERMAN ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion For Sanctions (Ccp 128.7) Against Plaintiff And Its Counsel Of Record; Memorandum Of Points And Authorities
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 13, 2026. Line 12. Defendant's Motion for Sanctions under CCP 128.7 is DENIED. The legal contentions in the Complaint are warranted by existing law, as reflected in the Court's ruling on Defendant's demurrer on July 1, 2026. As both of Defendant's arguments supporting this motion are based on his position that the Complaint is legally improper, the motion is denied in its entirety. Plaintiff's opposition is stricken, as it is untimely and was not properly served by a method described in CCP 1005(c), leaving Defendant no meaningful time for reply, and does not address the untimeliness or provide any reason why the Court should consider it in spite of the untimeliness.
